summary: North kerb runs directly past houses and apartments, 1-5 m from the road.
reasons: Dwellings 1-5 m from kerb along most of it
Como Apartments 3 m from far end
Nearest gap still within 13 m of homes

best_section.where: North kerb of Cunningham Street, in front of the large apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Apartments and detached houses front onto the kerb; the apartment block's frontage is within a few metres of the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park on the opposite kerb; this side is narrow with buildings against it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, rail line behind the apartments.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the south side, not clearly on this one; residents are adjacent.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of nearly the whole stretch
Weekday 7am-6pm no-parking signs; overnight not covered
sun_shade: Buildings shade it from the north; open to afternoon sun from the west.
